mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pd.exposure_count), 0) AS exposureCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.read_count), 0) AS readCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.like_count), 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.comment_count), 0) AS commentCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.click_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.del_flag = '0') AS clickCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.signup_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.del_flag = '0') AS signupCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.lead_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.del_flag = '0') AS leadCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_channel WHERE del_flag = '0' AND channel_status = '0') AS channelCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_content_package WHERE del_flag = '0' AND package_status = '1') AS publishedCount FROM mk_promotion_data pd WHERE pd.del_flag = '0' AND pd.data_date >= #{beginDate} AND pd.data_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT c.channel_type AS channelType, COUNT(DISTINCT c.channel_id) AS channelCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.package_id) AS packageCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.exposure_count), 0) AS exposureCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.read_count), 0) AS readCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.like_count), 0) AS likeCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.lead_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l JOIN mk_channel c2 ON l.channel_id = c2.channel_id WHERE l.del_flag = '0' AND c2.channel_type = c.channel_type) AS leadCount FROM mk_channel c LEFT JOIN mk_content_package p ON p.channel_id = c.channel_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mk_promotion_data pd ON pd.package_id = p.package_id AND pd.del_flag = '0' AND pd.data_date >= #{beginDate} AND pd.data_date <= #{endDate} WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.channel_type ORDER BY readCount DESC

SELECT p.package_id AS packageId, ct.title AS contentTitle, p.package_title AS packageTitle, p.channel_type AS channelType, p.package_status AS packageStatus, IFNULL(SUM(pd.exposure_count), 0) AS exposureCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.read_count), 0) AS readCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.like_count), 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.comment_count), 0) AS commentCount FROM mk_content_package p INNER JOIN mk_content ct ON p.content_id = ct.content_id AND ct.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mk_promotion_data pd ON pd.package_id = p.package_id AND pd.del_flag = '0' AND pd.data_date >= #{beginDate} AND pd.data_date <= #{endDate} WHERE p.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY p.package_id, ct.title, p.package_title, p.channel_type, p.package_status ORDER BY readCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.activity_id = #{activityId} AND l.del_flag = '0') AS channelCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.click_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.activity_id = #{activityId} AND l.del_flag = '0') AS clickCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.signup_count), 0) FROM mk_activity_channel_link l WHERE l.activity_id = #{activityId} AND l.del_flag = '0') AS signupCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_lead WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND del_flag = '0') AS leadCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_opportunity o INNER JOIN mk_lead l2 ON o.lead_id = l2.lead_id WHERE l2.activity_id = #{activityId} AND o.del_flag = '0' AND l2.del_flag = '0') AS opportunityCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mk_opportunity o INNER JOIN mk_lead l3 ON o.lead_id = l3.lead_id WHERE l3.activity_id = #{activityId} AND o.del_flag = '0' AND l3.del_flag = '0' AND o.opportunity_status = '1') AS dealCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pd.data_date, '%m-%d') AS dataDate, IFNULL(SUM(pd.exposure_count), 0) AS exposureCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.read_count), 0) AS readCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.like_count), 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.comment_count), 0) AS commentCount FROM mk_promotion_data pd WHERE pd.del_flag = '0' AND pd.data_date >= #{beginDate} AND pd.data_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pd.data_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY pd.data_date
